gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Nostalgic from the first glyph, Mystery Quest gives headings curves that stay open and compact ascenders. But Noto Sans Hanunoo does the quieter work, filling most of the height with open-ended lowercase.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Mystery Quest brings a bookish, nostalgic voice, with ascenders kept compact and every curve left gaping at the jaw. And Noto Sans Hebrew handles the quiet work, its wide midsection filling the line.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-hk: Curves left gaping at the jaw give Mystery Quest its bookish, nostalgic look, with compact ascenders on top. Noto Sans HK then reads smoothly down the page, large lowercase and lifted brush ends keeping each paragraph crisp.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP reads broad and modern, with a lofty x-height and curves that sweep open rather than curl shut. Shrink Mystery Quest and its bookish, nostalgic charm gets lost.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Storybook curves with a wistful, bookish lean, courtesy of Mystery Quest. The heading handles nostalgic display flair, while Noto Sans Kaithi does the everyday work, its lowercase filling the line like capitals.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Mystery Quest wears its nostalgic, bookish side openly, with curves left gaping and ascenders kept compact. And Noto Sans Kayah Li handles the body, capitals barely taller than lowercase and brush ends lifted away.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest leaves its curves gaping. Noto Sans Khmer carves chisel-notch openings into near-capital lowercase, so the body size can stay modest without losing clarity.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao pushes its x-height well above the usual, keeping every mouth open. But Mystery Quest owns the bookish, nostalgic display moments, with compact ascenders and curves left gaping.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-lao-loope: Wide-mouthed curves set Mystery Quest apart, lending a bookish, nostalgic bite above compact ascenders. Noto Sans Lao Looped then follows with solid word blocks, its bowls left unfinished on one side.
